'''Yellowstrike Spaceport''' was a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] that served as the largest landing site in the [[Seventh Octant]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Poln Minor|Poln Minor]]. A network of tunnels leading from the spaceport provided access to other parts of the octant.<ref name="COO" />
